en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of an ornate, classical-style building labeled 'Läroverket' in Sundsvall, Sweden. The building has large arches, columns, and elaborate architectural details. The front has both printed and handwritten text. On the reverse, there is a Swedish postage stamp (5 öre) and an address handwritten in elegant script, with several Swedish words and addresses present.
